problem_text:
A logistics firm must dispatch a technician to perform maintenance checks at eight distinct facilities scattered across a region.

The travel durations between facilities, recorded in minutes, are as follows:
* Facility 1 to 2: 160.5 minutes
* Facility 1 to 3: 15.0 minutes
* Facility 1 to 4: 65.2 minutes
* Facility 1 to 5: 138.1 minutes
* Facility 1 to 6: 99.9 minutes
* Facility 1 to 7: 135.6 minutes
* Facility 1 to 8: 105.7 minutes
* Facility 2 to 3: 151.1 minutes
* Facility 2 to 4: 127.8 minutes
* Facility 2 to 5: 138.8 minutes
* Facility 2 to 6: 84.2 minutes
* Facility 2 to 7: 102.2 minutes
* Facility 2 to 8: 61.3 minutes
* Facility 3 to 4: 69.0 minutes
* Facility 3 to 5: 142.4 minutes
* Facility 3 to 6: 97.3 minutes
* Facility 3 to 7: 136.0 minutes
* Facility 3 to 8: 99.3 minutes
* Facility 4 to 5: 73.5 minutes
* Facility 4 to 6: 46.9 minutes
* Facility 4 to 7: 72.3 minutes
* Facility 4 to 8: 66.5 minutes
* Facility 5 to 6: 68.6 minutes
* Facility 5 to 7: 37.0 minutes
* Facility 5 to 8: 93.6 minutes
* Facility 6 to 7: 43.9 minutes
* Facility 6 to 8: 26.7 minutes
* Facility 7 to 8: 63.7 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit, whereby the technician must visit every facility precisely once, concluding the tour back at the initial facility from which they departed.
